titre: Why was the UN created? (cause / conséquence)
description: Les origines de l'ONU (schéma) et les connecteurs de cause / conséquence + nom.

questions.question: Which root led to the objective « Protecting human rights »?
choix: the crimes committed by the Nazis and Hitler
the world economic crisis of the 1930s
the failure of the League of Nations
questions.explication: Les crimes nazis → protéger les droits de l'homme.

questions.question: Which roots led to the objective « Securing peace »?
choix: the Second World War and the failure of the League of Nations
the crimes committed by the Nazis only
the world economic crisis of the 1930s
questions.explication: La Seconde Guerre mondiale et l'échec de la SDN → garantir la paix.

questions.question: Which root led to the objective « Economic and social development »?
choix: the crimes committed by the Nazis
the world economic crisis of the 1930s
the failure of the League of Nations
the invention of the atomic bomb
questions.explication: La crise économique mondiale des années 1930 → développement économique et social.

questions.question: What are the three tasks / objectives of the UN in the diagram? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: Securing peace (au centre), protecting human rights, economic and social development — les deux derniers contribuent aussi à la paix (flèches).

questions.question: In the diagram, what do « Protecting human rights » and « Economic and social development » point to?
questions.explication: Les deux objectifs servent l'objectif central : garantir la paix.

questions.question: Which phrases are followed by a noun or a noun phrase? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: due to / because of / owing to / thanks to / as a result of / as a consequence of + nom. « because » et « so that » sont suivis d'une proposition (sujet + verbe).

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choix: The UN was created because of the League of Nations failed.
The UN was created because the failure of the League of Nations.
The UN was created because of the failure of the League of Nations.
The UN was created due to the League of Nations failed.
questions.explication: because of + nom ; because + sujet + verbe.

questions.question: Which phrase introduces a POSITIVE cause?
« ___, a new organization was created. » (a full sentence follows)
questions.explication: As a result / As a consequence, + phrase complète ; as a result of + nom.

questions.question: Cause / effect phrases + noun
questions.verso: due to = en raison de · because of = à cause de · owing to = en raison de · thanks to = grâce à · as a result of / as a consequence of = par suite de, en conséquence de. Tous suivis d'un nom ou groupe nominal.

questions.question: League of Nations
questions.verso: la Société des Nations (SDN), créée en 1920 après la Première Guerre mondiale ; elle n'a pas pu empêcher la Seconde Guerre mondiale → remplacée par l'ONU en 1945.

questions.question: ___ the crimes committed by the Nazis and Hitler, the UN decided to protect human rights. (indice : en raison de — 2 mots)
The UN was created ___ the failure of the League of Nations. (indice : à cause de)
The UN was founded as a ___ of the Second World War. (indice : conséquence)
As a result ___ the world economic crisis of the 1930s, the UN promotes economic and social development.
___ to the UN, millions of refugees receive humanitarian aid. (indice : grâce à)
The League of Nations ___ to prevent the Second World War. (indice : échouer, prétérit)
Modèle de réponse (6 phrases)
questions.verso: 1. Due to the crimes committed by the Nazis and Hitler, the UN was tasked with protecting human rights. 2. Because of the Second World War, the Allies wanted to secure peace. 3. Owing to the failure of the League of Nations, a new organization was needed. 4. As a consequence of the world economic crisis of the 1930s, the UN promotes economic and social development. 5. As a result of these events, 51 countries signed the Charter in 1945. 6. Thanks to the UN, human rights are protected by international law.
